run_coco_zero_shot_eval: run the FLAVA zero-shot image-text retrieval evaluation on the COCO dataset with recall metrics
run_compute_recall: run the compute_recall function to calculate top-k recall from similarity scores
run_transform: run the transform function to apply image and text preprocessing to COCO captions
run_collator: run the collator function to batch and stack images and text tensors for the dataloader
run_setup_args: run the setup_args function to parse CLI arguments for data root, annotations, and batch size
